hook: Telangana flags flu risk as temps dip *2-3°C* below normal
hook_b: Telangana flags flu risk as temps dip *2-3°C* below normal
tldr: The Director of Public Health warned that dry, cold weather could raise acute respiratory infections and listed precautions and warning signs.

beats.what: The advisory asks people with symptoms to stay home, cover coughs, wash hands often and avoid crowded places.
beats.why: Dry weather and falling temperatures can increase the spread of respiratory infections, said Dr B Ravinder Nayak.
beats.care: High fever, breathing trouble, bluish lips, blood in sputum or altered behaviour need care at a govt facility; call 108 for an ambulance.

effects.label: Higher risk for elderly, kids under 5

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Times of India (Nov 18): Most people recover within a week with rest and fluids, the advisory says.

cards.q: Has anyone at home caught a cold or flu this week?

qs: Are govt clinics seeing more respiratory cases this week?

facts.t: Seniors above *65*, kids under 5, pregnant women and the chronically ill face higher risk.

viz.l: What the advisory says to do
viz.verdict: Most recover in a week; some need a doctor

watch: Whether govt hospitals report a rise in respiratory cases as the cold spell continues.
